GDP drifter directory files dirfl_*.dat: 29,026 drifters put in 1979-2025, with start, end, drogue-off date and death code
AOML GDP FAQ: the drogue 'is centered at a depth of 15 meters'; without it 'the wind and waves play a greater role in moving the drifter'
AOML drogue-detection README: drogue-off dates 1992-2010 re-estimated, drogue-off time 'misdiagnosed as drogue-on' (Lumpkin et al. 2013)
of 12.16 million drifter-days with a readable drogue record, 6.61 million (54 %) were carried, drogue already off; median days with a drogue 132

of 1,109 drifters carried more than three years, 81 % last heard between 20 and 40 degrees of latitude, against 35 % of those still following (exploratory); the 10 longest carried all near 30 N/S far offshore
